name: nuxt
description: Nuxt engineering and review knowledge for server-rendered Vue: per-request state with useState rather than module scope, useFetch and useAsyncData, runtimeConfig public versus private, hydration mismatches, Nitro server routes and route middleware. A delta on top of the vue pack -- it carries only what server rendering inverts or adds, and names the plain-Vue rules that must not be applied here. Framework-level only, and version-gated. Contains no facts about any individual repository.
